description: Paper Fig. 2 / Fig. 1 -- blobs on a circle. Appendix C gives 2x256 LeakyReLU nets, size-16 latents, 5000 training steps, 5 seeds, latents centred to mean 0, and '1-3-9' loop latents. The paper states no dataset, optimizer, learning rate or batch size, so those follow the authors' released code (github.com/orcacomputing/quantum-latent-distributions): 7 blobs on a radius-5 circle with polar noise, Adam betas (0.0, 0.9) at 5e-4, batch 32, gradient penalty 10.
